A '''motor-sled''' was a ground vehicle employed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Thera Capens' friend|friend]] of [[Thera Capens]] owned one of these vehicles.
